svg.title: Riju rises between Vale and Ila to accept the overnight integration drive.
svg.desc: Vale asks whether Riju can meet the target without erasing uncertainty. Riju stands with his badge hidden by the satchel strap and accepts, while Ila stays seated with both hands on the red ledger.
svg.text: Page 21, panel 5 · Low three-quarter shot as Riju rises to accept the assignment
